effects.name: Spellcasting Implement
effects.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +20 : Passive: +20 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power .

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Purifying Flame Lore
effects.tooltip: Purifying Flame Lore +16 : Passive: Your Fire and Light spells gain a +16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

effects.name: Power of the Flames of Purity
effects.tooltip: Power of the Flames of Purity +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Fire and Light Spell Power.

effects.name: Flaming Blast
effects.tooltip: Flaming Blast 4 : This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 4d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.

effects.name: Coruscating
effects.tooltip: Coruscating 4 : This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 4d6 Light damage on each hit.

effects.name: Greater Incineration
effects.tooltip: Greater Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage. This damage will be dealt more often than a standard Incineration weapon.

flavor_text: This tool was crafted for divine priests of the Silver Flame, as well as those who would wield a quarterstaff as a weapon in the Silver Flame's name. It deals fire and light damage to its targets and enhances the power of magical light and flames.
